title: Uphawu Phakathi Kwamatye
intro: Kwilizwe apho iintaba zaziqoshwe zaba zizindlu, kwafika umthunywa ephethe umqondiso omangalisayo ovela ku-Allah. Abantu bafuna ubungqina, baza bafumana isidalwa esivela edwaleni eliqinileyo. Kodwa ukuzikhukhumeza kwabo kwabakhokelela ekubeni bangasithobeli isilumkiso, nto leyo eyabagcina bekhuselekile.
clues: Ndathunyelwa kubantu ababehlala kwiindawo zokuhlala eziqingqiwe ezintabeni.
Bandicelile ukuba ndizise umqondiso, ngoko ke ndavelisa inkamela eliweni.
Ndibaxelele ukuba bavumele ikamela isele amanzi ngokukhululekileyo kwaye bangayilimazi.
Abazange bathobele baza bayinqumla imisipha inkamela, bengayithobeli isilumkiso sam.
Ndathi isohlwayo siza kufika emva kweentsuku ezintathu.
Ekuseni, ukuqhuma okukhulu kwabatshabalalisa, kodwa mna nabalandeli bam sasinda.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
